fields.description: Fahid Beach Residences is a coastal collection on Fahid Island in Abu Dhabi. Apartments, duplexes and townhouses offer different ways to live near the shoreline, with shared spaces for fitness, relaxation, children and working from home. The original collection also includes a five bedroom penthouse category.

overview: Koichi Takada’s design is identified in the official brochure. The published plan set includes several one-bedroom arrangements, apartments with study or maid space, and both levels of the duplex and townhouse layouts. A matching bedroom count does not mean the same indoor/outdoor balance.
research.locationNote: The address is on Fahid Island in Abu Dhabi. Confirm the building, orientation and assigned access route; a waterfront masterplan does not guarantee an uninterrupted sea view from every home.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists an AED 3.5m launch price and marks the development sold out. Treat the number as a launch reference; an available developer or resale home requires its own current quotation.
research.paymentNote: The original factsheet gives 10% down payment and a 65/35 structure: 55% further payments before completion, then 35% at handover. Later promotions or resale arrangements may differ.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2029. The original factsheet described handovers starting Q1 and finishing Q2 2029; that launch window is not a guarantee for every home. Confirm the building-specific contractual date.
